rationale: To differentiate from the generic dark 'Web3/crypto' look and the typical OnlyFans aesthetic, OnlyBase uses a clean, editorial, Swiss-Brutalist approach. This 'Coinbase-level polish' builds trust, feels premium, and ensures the content (which is free to view) takes center stage. The Base native blue (#0052FF) is used exclusively for the coveted verified badge and key brand accents to make it pop against the stark monochrome UI.

typography.notes: Headings must be tightly tracked. Never use Inter. Keep line heights tight on headings and loose on body text.

layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white relative shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) for standard views. Posts in feed should have p-4.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Use 1px crisp borders (border-gray-200) to separate feed items and layout sections. No soft fuzzy shadows.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: Rounded elements should use rounded-2xl or rounded-full for avatars/buttons. Keep it friendly but crisp.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile feel, with glassmorphism (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-gray-100). Sticky top header for context.

components.verification_badge: Use Phosphor's <SealCheck weight='fill' className='text-[#0052FF]' />. This perfectly replicates the scalloped cloud-edge Twitter-style badge.
components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-black text-white rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-semibold hover:bg-gray-800 transition-colors. Subscribe/Tip buttons can use the brand primary #0052FF for emphasis.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs customized with rounded-xl, 1px border-gray-200, focus:border-black focus:ring-1 focus:ring-black.
components.feed_post: Edge-to-edge layout inside the container. Top: Avatar + Name + Badge + Handle. Middle: Free content (text/image). Bottom: Action bar (Like, Comment, Tip/Share) using Iconoir or Phosphor icons.
components.wallet_card: A stark, beautifully padded card (p-6, rounded-2xl, bg-black text-white) showing ETH/USDC balance, to look like a premium credit card or Coinbase wallet interface.
components.swap_interface: Clean, large typography for inputs (e.g., text-4xl). Token selectors with rounded-full icons. Minimalist approach.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must darken or lighten on hover/tap. Feed posts slightly dim on tap.
motion_and_interactions.tabs: Smooth slide indicator for tabs (e.g., Feed vs Discover).

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor icons. Weight 'regular' for inactive tabs/actions, 'fill' for active tabs, 'fill' for the SealCheck verification badge.

logos.description: OnlyBase modern logo text with blue badge

testing.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs, modal triggers) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case representing the role, e.g., data-testid='feed-like-button', data-testid='wallet-swap-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first web app mimicking a native iOS/Android experience. Wrap the main view in a div with 'max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white relative shadow-2xl' to enforce the mobile aspect ratio on desktop.
Implement a sticky top header and fixed bottom navigation bar for core routes: Home (Feed), Discover, Swap, Messages, Profile.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) globally. Use <SealCheck weight='fill' className='text-[#0052FF]' /> for the iconic Twitter-style verification badge.
The Feed must be public and free to view. Posts should have no paywalls. Integrate an anti-NSFW policy reminder in the 'Create Post' flow.
Messages tab should have locked conversations requiring a subscription fee to the creator. Show a padlock icon and clear 'Subscribe to message' CTAs.
Wallet & Swap tab must be pristine, similar to Coinbase Wallet or Uniswap. Use large typography for balances and a clean interface for token swaps.
Use Google Fonts: 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body. Configure them in Tailwind.
Enforce strict accessibility contrast, ensuring text is readable over backgrounds.
